title: Dimension-Calibrated Unexplained Mass: An Interpretable Drift Statistic for Contamination Monitoring in Data Streams
abstract: arXiv:2607.16811v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Drift detectors that work tend not to explain themselves, and drift detectors that explain themselves tend to fail in high dimension. We close that gap for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs): each fitted component is a named "regime," and the fraction of a stream window matching no regime -- its unexplained mass -- is a drift signal that is simultaneously its own explanation. We identify why this statistic collapses in high dimension and repair it. Under a correct component a normal point in d dimensions lies about sqrt(d) sigma from the mean, so once d exceeds 9 essentially every point exceeds a fixed 3-sigma radius: window-level ROC-AUC is exactly 0.50 on Satellite (d=36) and Optdigits (d=64). Calibrating the radius to sqrt(chi-squared_d(0.99)) removes the collapse -- AUC 1.00 and 0.89 -- while leaving low dimensions unchanged. translated_title: 维度校准的未解释质量：数据流污染监测的一种可解释漂移统计量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.16811v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：能工作的漂移检测器往往无法自我解释，而能自我解释的漂移检测器在高维情况下往往失效。我们针对高斯混合模型（GMM）弥合了这一差距：每个拟合的分量被命名为“机制”，流窗口中未匹配任何机制的比例——即其未解释质量——是一种漂移信号，同时它本身就是其解释。我们识别了该统计量在高维下崩溃的原因并修复了它。在正确的分量下，d维空间中的正常点大约位于距离均值sqrt(d) sigma处，因此一旦d超过9，几乎所有点都会超过固定的3-sigma半径：在Satellite（d=36）和Optdigits（d=64）上，窗口级ROC-AUC正好为0.50。将半径校准为sqrt(chi-squared_d(0.99))可消除崩溃——AUC分别达到1.00和0.89——同时保持低维情况不变。在七个公开基准、五个随机种子和八个无模型检测器（涵盖核、分类器、p）上进行了测试。
tldr: 我们提出一种基于高斯混合模型的“未解释质量”漂移统计量，通过维度校准半径修复高维崩溃问题，使其在保持可解释性的同时显著提升检测性能。
en_tdlr: We propose an interpretable drift statistic based on Gaussian mixture models' unexplained mass, fixing high-dimensional collapse via dimension-calibrated radii, enhancing detection performance while preserving explainability.
